BusinessModel: Runs an app-based shopping marketplace connecting small sellers to value-seeking buyers, mostly in smaller towns. Earns service fees on a zero-commission model. Also owns the Valmo logistics brand.
RevenueStreams: Marketplace service + advertising fees majority (FY25 mix not disclosed); logistics/Valmo fees; other income; total Rs 9388 cr FY25 vs Rs 7615 cr FY24
Expenses: Operating/logistics + marketing costs dominate (total Rs 9943 cr FY25); depreciation Rs 34 cr; interest Rs 7 cr; OPM about -6% FY25
TAM: India e-commerce roughly USD 120-150 bn GMV 2024 (industry reports)
PL_Top3_Contributors: 1) Advertising and seller service fees on order volume growth; 2) Valmo logistics fee income; 3) Marketing and logistics spend vs grocery and tier-2+ volume growth

BusinessModel: Processes milk and makes premium dairy products like paneer, curd and ghee. Sells packaged value-added dairy through retail across India. Focuses on higher-margin products rather than liquid milk.
RevenueStreams: Value-added dairy (paneer, curd, ghee, cheese) dominant (product split not disclosed); Rs 2328 cr FY25 vs Rs 1803 cr FY24
Expenses: Raw milk dominant cost head; interest Rs 86 cr FY25; borrowings Rs 1375 cr FY25; OPM 13% FY25
TAM: India dairy roughly Rs 13-14 lakh crore with VADP growing double digits (industry estimates FY24-25)
PL_Top3_Contributors: 1) Value-added product margins; 2) raw milk procurement cost swings; 3) interest burden on FY25 debt of Rs 1375 cr

BusinessModel: Builds portable point-of-care molecular diagnostic devices and test chips, best known for the Truenat TB testing platform. Sells instruments plus recurring consumable chips to health programmes globally.
RevenueStreams: Truenat instruments + test chip consumables (split not disclosed); Rs 971 cr FY25 vs Rs 756 cr FY24
Expenses: Total expenses Rs 746 cr FY25; interest Rs 9 cr; OPM 23% FY25; almost debt free
TAM: Global POC molecular diagnostics multi-billion dollar growing double digits (industry estimates); exact split data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: 1) Recurring test chip sales on installed Truenat base; 2) government TB programme and export instrument sales; 3) mix shift toward high-margin consumables

BusinessModel: Designs and builds electrical equipment for railways, including IGBT-based propulsion systems for electric locomotives, switchgear and control systems. Supplies rolling-stock makers and railway customers.
RevenueStreams: Railway propulsion and electrical sub-systems (split not disclosed); Rs 63 cr FY25 vs Rs 50 cr FY24
Expenses: Total expenses Rs 55 cr FY25; interest Rs 4 cr; borrowings Rs 32 cr FY25; OPM 12% FY25
TAM: Part of Indian Railways multi-lakh-crore capex programme; exact segment TAM data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: 1) Loco propulsion and control-system orders; 2) execution margins on sub-systems; 3) interest cost of Rs 4 cr vs Rs 1 cr profit base

BusinessModel: Runs India's largest dialysis network under the NephroPlus brand via standalone centres, hospital captive clinics and government PPP units. Patients return several times weekly, creating repeat revenue.
RevenueStreams: PPP dialysis contracts + private-pay centres + home dialysis (split not disclosed); Rs 630 cr FY25 vs Rs 544 cr FY24
Expenses: Operating costs ~86% of Rs 541 cr FY25; depreciation Rs 58 cr; interest Rs 50 cr; OPM 14% FY25
TAM: India dialysis market commonly estimated Rs 25000-35000 cr with severe under-treatment (industry estimates); exact TAM data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: 1) PPP contract volumes; 2) private-pay centre realisations; 3) new-clinic ramp costs plus interest and depreciation

BusinessModel: Makes high-precision engineered components for safety-critical industrial uses and exports them worldwide. Also builds turnkey industrial automation systems and custom mechanical solutions.
RevenueStreams: Precision components + turnkey automation (split not disclosed); Rs 345 cr FY25 vs Rs 188 cr FY24; TTM Rs 575 cr
Expenses: Total expenses Rs 230 cr FY25; depreciation Rs 37 cr; interest Rs 29 cr; OPM 33% FY25
TAM: Global precision components and industrial automation, multi-billion-dollar market; segment TAM data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: 1) Export demand for precision components; 2) turnkey automation margins; 3) working-capital cycle with 172 debtor days deciding cash conversion

BusinessModel: Builds power transmission infrastructure on turnkey contracts - HV/EHV lines, substations and underground cabling - covering design through commissioning and O&M for utilities.
RevenueStreams: Turnkey transmission lines + substations + cabling (split not disclosed); Rs 279 cr FY25 vs Rs 183 cr FY24
Expenses: Total expenses Rs 244 cr FY25; interest Rs 6 cr; depreciation Rs 1 cr; OPM 13% FY25; borrowings Rs 19 cr FY25
TAM: India transmission capex of several lakh crore planned FY25-32 (CEA/National Electricity Plan); company share data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: 1) Transmission project execution margins; 2) order-book conversion pace; 3) commodity price moves on fixed-price contracts

BusinessModel: Runs a chain of about 14-17 NABH multi-specialty hospitals with 4000+ beds across North India. Earns from surgeries, inpatient stays, outpatient visits, diagnostics and pharmacy, led by cardiac, neuro, renal and cancer care.
RevenueStreams: Inpatient + outpatient + pharmacy + diagnostics (split not disclosed); standalone Rs 92 cr FY25 vs Rs 90 cr FY24; FY26 Rs 129 cr
Expenses: FY26 total expenses Rs 77 cr; interest Rs 13 cr; depreciation Rs 5 cr; OPM 26% FY25; borrowings cut to Rs 19 cr Mar 2026
TAM: North India tertiary healthcare within India's multi-lakh-crore private hospital market (industry estimates FY25); exact TAM data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: 1) Inpatient surgeries and occupancy in key specialties; 2) case-mix shift to high-ARPOB procedures; 3) new-hospital ramp costs plus interest and depreciation

BusinessModel: Sells diamond and gemstone-studded gold and platinum jewellery under the Reva brand through stores and online. Earns the spread between retail price and the cost of gold, diamonds and stones.
RevenueStreams: Studded jewellery retail (product split not disclosed); Rs 64 cr FY25 vs Rs 196 cr FY24
Expenses: Total expenses Rs 139 cr FY24; borrowings rose from Rs 0 to Rs 91 cr FY25; OPM 15% FY25
TAM: India jewellery industry roughly USD 80-100 bn with organised studded segment growing faster (industry estimates FY25); exact TAM data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: 1) Studded-jewellery making-charge margins; 2) gold and diamond price swings on inventory; 3) interest on new Rs 91 cr FY25 debt vs shrunken revenue

BusinessModel: Makes diesel generator sets and medium-speed large generators through a 40+ year Cummins OEM tie-up, and builds wind power projects as an independent power producer with EPC and O&M services.
RevenueStreams: DG sets + MSLG + wind IPP/EPC/O&M (split not disclosed); Rs 2496 cr FY25 vs Rs 2195 cr FY24
Expenses: Total expenses Rs 2196 cr FY25; depreciation Rs 116 cr; interest Rs 32 cr; OPM 12% FY25; borrowings Rs 308 cr Mar 2025
TAM: India DG market commonly estimated Rs 15000-20000 cr plus ~100 GW wind target by 2030 (industry/MNRE estimates); split data not found
